head: 454 of 533 sitting members with a record in this collection
deck: Sitting members count through gifts to committees linked to them, outside spending for or against them from all donors, or other public records involving Anthropic’s network.The network includes Anthropic, its employees and directors, its funders and other AI-safety funders, the groups they back that work with Congress, and their officers, PACs and lobbyists.
note: The records leave the effect on votes open.
bridge: First, gifts from Anthropic’s employees and PAC.

head: Anthropic employee and PAC gifts reached 10 of today’s members by the end of 2024 and 201 by Sept. 2026.
deck: Anthropic employees gave $6.0M of their own money, 92% of it in 2026. Anthropic’s political action committee (PAC) gave $232K.
note: Employer is as the giver reported it to the FEC, including misspellings and entries in the occupation box. The amounts are gross contributions before refunds. The record runs through Sept. 30, 2026.
bridge: Anthropic separately announced funding for a political nonprofit. How much?
source: FEC contributions to campaigns, leadership PACs and single-member joint fundraising committees linked to serving members.

head: Commonwealth Together PAC reported paying against Seth Moulton as early as April 1, 2026, before its Aug. 3 receipt from Public First Action.
deck: Anthropic announced $40.0M for Public First Action, a nonprofit, in 2026.
note: The filings give no reason for the spending. No filing in this record lists Public First Action’s donors.
bridge: Lobbyists’ own gifts are another way a hollow seat counts. How far did those gifts reach?
source: Sources · Anthropic’s announcement pages and the PAC’s FEC filings
